title: feat(service-settings): warn when a settings value misses the format its type declares (18.x half, 「甲」)
body:
Part of #24882. This PR is the 18.x warning half only; refusing these values is the next major's half, which the `domain:services` seat files when this lands.

Clause-②: no (warning only: every save and every `OS_*` override accepted before is still accepted, with the same value stored or served, the same status and the same errors)

## What changes

ADR-0007's specifier table declares a value format for four types: `email` / `url` / `phone` take "format validation", and `color` takes a "hex string". Nothing judged it. `PUT /api/settings/branding` stored a Logo URL of `not a url` and answered 200, and an `OS_*` override was served unchecked.

`packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-service.ts` now judges that format at both doors through one shared helper, `firstFormatMiss(type, value)`. The helper returns a verdict that carries the ADR-0114 code the refusal will use (`invalid_email` / `invalid_url` / `invalid_phone` / `invalid_format`). Both call sites report a miss and keep the value:

- **Save door (`validatePatch`).** The format branch runs after every refusal family, so the errors a refused patch carries are exactly what they were. A miss is collected, never pushed to `errors`. When the patch as a whole is accepted, one `warn` line is logged per key, naming the namespace, key, type, the expected format and the value's length.
- **Env door (`effectiveEnvOverride`).** The format is judged last, only on an override that every refusal family has already let through. A miss draws one `warn` line, deduplicated per (variable, value) like the existing rejection report. The override stays in force: it is served with `source: 'env'` and it still locks the key. `auditEnvOverrides` also walks format-typed keys, so the line arrives at boot rather than on a first read.
- **The value is never printed** in either line, for any key. That covers the secret-bearing case, and it keeps an environment variable's value out of the log.

The grammars are the platform's existing ones for the same words, not new dialects:

| type | grammar | why this one |
|---|---|---|
| `email` | local@domain with a dotted domain, no spaces | the address check of `plugin-email`, the live reader of `mail.from_email`. A value without a warning is one the transport can send from. `no-reply@localhost` warns. |
| `url` | `scheme://…`, a root-relative `/path`, `data:`, or `blob:` | the record validator's `url` field grammar. Not http(s)-only: the reader of `branding.logo_url` (`RuntimeConfigPlugin.logoUrl`) declares "absolute or relative URL", and storage hands back `/api/v1/storage/files/…` for an upload. |
| `phone` | digits, spaces and `+ ( ) - .`, at least 5 characters | the record validator's `phone` field grammar. No shipped manifest authors a `phone` specifier (`company.phone` is `text`). |
| `color` | `#rgb`, `#rgba`, `#rrggbb`, `#rrggbbaa` | CSS hex notation. ADR-0007 says "hex string", the picker emits `#rrggbb`, and the reader serves it as a browser theme colour. |

Empty values, blank values and non-string values are not judged, matching how `firstPatternMiss` treats them. Surrounding whitespace is ignored because both live readers trim before use.

## 「甲」 reading

The standing rule (#6015, comment 6292005854), verbatim: "No conversion can carry it: 18.x ships only the loud half (a warning, an explain line, a reported event). The refusal is filed for 19.0."

The seat's derivation for this card is comment 6302777692:

- Refusing a malformed `email` / `url` / `phone` / `color` save narrows what the settings door accepts today.
- Stored values live in `sys_setting` (runtime state). An `OS_*` override is a deployment environment value. No ADR-0087 conversion can rewrite either.
- So 18.x warns.

This PR implements exactly that:

- No `FieldError`, no `400` and no new `409` anywhere.
- The response shape is unchanged.
- Every stored and served value is byte-identical to before.

The pins below assert all of this through the real route. The refusal half reads `miss.code` from the verdict, so turning the warning into a `FieldError` changes the two call sites and nothing else.

**Where the warning reaches.** Measured at `7adfaec2a`:

- The `PUT` answer is `{ values }` only.
- `setMany` returns a record of `ResolvedSettingValue` keyed by setting, which has no advisory member.
- The `settings:changed` event (`SettingsChangeEventSchema`) and the two audit sinks carry no advisory member either.

So the server log, through the service's existing `logger.warn` (wired from `ctx.logger`; `console.warn` without one), is the only surface reachable without a new response member. Whether a log-only warning is loud enough for an admin saving in Setup is put to the seat as a decision in the report. The console half (constraint validation on Save) is objectui's, beside objectstack-ai/objectui#13239.

## Tests

New file `packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-format-warning.test.ts`, with 31 cases. The save door is driven through the real route (`registerSettingsRoutes` over a real `SettingsService`, as `settings-routes.test.ts` does). Status starts at 0, so `200` is asserted rather than defaulted. The env door is driven through `get`, `getNamespace` and the `PUT` lock.

- Per type, on every shipped key with the type: `branding.logo_url`, `company.website`, `branding.accent_color`, `company.primary_contact_email` and `mail.from_email`, plus a synthetic `phone` key.
  - A malformed save answers 200, is stored as written, and draws exactly one warning naming namespace, key and type, without the value.
  - A well-formed save draws none.
- Per type at the env door:
  - A malformed override is in force (`source: 'env'`, `locked: true`, a save still answers 409). It draws exactly one warning, at boot, which re-reads do not repeat.
  - A well-formed override draws none.
- A secret-bearing `email` key at both doors: the value and its fragments never appear in the warning.
- Precedence: a value refused for `maxLength` carries only the `max_length` FieldError. A batch refused for one key stores nothing and warns about nothing.
- The other shapes each grammar admits (relative, `data:` and `http:` logos, 3/4/6/8-digit hex, a padded email) draw no warning. Empty and blank values draw no warning.
- The synthetic fixture parses under `SettingsManifestSchema`.

Readings on the final head `b3b236b77`, each through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (VERDICT command-exit 0):

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings run typecheck`: exit 0. The program includes the new test (`tsc --listFiles`, 57 test files).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: 57 files, 960 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over `auth-settings-ordering.pin`, `auth-settings-seeded-boot.pin` and `auth-settings-refusal-isolation`: 3 files, 13 tests passed. These import `service-settings` from source.

## Ablations

Each leg ran on `b3b236b77` with the implementation committed. The mutation went through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode: the anchor hit 1 time and fell to 0, and the blob changed on disk. A trap-armed wrapper then ran the format pins and restored the file. The restore is proven with blob == HEAD (`f3caa344f9a9`) and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The tests import the service from source, so no `dist/` is involved.

| leg | mutation | result |
|---|---|---|
| A1 | the judge accepts everything (`return null`) | 14 red: every malformed-value pin at both doors, the secret-bearing ones included (`expected [] to have a length of 1 but got +0`) |
| A2s | the save door refuses a miss (`errors.push` + `continue`) | 8 red: the 7 save-door malformed pins (`expected 400 to be 200`), and the precedence pin (`[ 'support_phone', 'docs_url' ]` vs `[ 'docs_url' ]`) |
| A2e | the env door rejects a miss (`return null`) | 7 red: every env-door malformed pin (`expected null to be …`, `expected [] to have a length of 1`) |
| A3 | the judge flags every value | 13 red: every well-formed pin at both doors, and the other-shapes pin |
| A4 | the warning echoes the value | 14 red: every malformed pin at both doors, the two secret-bearing pins included (`expected … not to contain …`) |
| A5 | the value is judged untrimmed | 1 red: the other-shapes pin (padded email) |

## Gates

Gate commands were derived from this worktree with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) on `b3b236b77`: 67 commands. Each ran locally, with its exit code captured before any pipe. The readings are in the os-dev report on the card. CI owns the families outside that list.

## Acceptance notes

- Grammar mirrors. The email grammar is now spelled in four places: the record validator, the rule validator, `plugin-email` and this file. The url and phone grammars are spelled in two places each, and the record validator's and rule validator's phone grammars already differ. No shared predicate exists in `packages/spec`, and nothing pins the copies equal. Owner: none.
- Non-string values on string-persisting specifiers. ADR-0007 says "Persists: string". A number written to `logo_url` is stored as given and dropped by the branding reader. That is a type constraint, not a format, so it is left alone here exactly as `pattern` leaves it. It was not measured at a public door. Owner: none.
- `company.phone` is authored as `type: 'text'` with an "E.164 recommended" description, so no phone format applies to the one phone-like shipped key. The manifests are outside this card. Owner: none.
